text:
Alex: morning async — quick checkin for gateway/routing/auth/rate limits.
Alex: what I did: landed gateway patch to surface route-level quota metrics, ran basic smoke against staging. saw one unexpected 429 spike on /v1/embed.
Alex: blocker: still seeing intermittent 429s at ~100 req/s in staging that don't line up with expected burst window. Need help validating token-bucket config.
Maria: noted, can you paste the ratepolicy and the burst config you used?
Alex: sure — policy snippet:```json
{
  \"route\": \"/v1/embed\",
  \"limit\": 600000,
  \"window_ms\": 60000,
  \"burst_tokens\": 150
}```
Alex: I also ran a quick `wrk` against the canary: `wrk -t4 -c200 -d30s http://staging-gw/v1/embed` — saw 5% 429s around 18s.
Sam: pinged — I can look after standup. Two quick questions: is this per-token or per-request accounting?
Alex: per-request for now (we're counting requests at the gateway layer; token accounting lives later in the stack).
Sam: ok. I'll check the token-bucket implementation and the leaky-bucket smoothing. Might be a race when nodes spin up.
Jamal: FYI I updated the auth proxy image to include a retry-logic change (adds 100ms jitter). Rolling it to staging now. Might explain timing differences.
Leah: quick heads up — I merged the PR for route priority ordering (helps fallback selection). @Alex that could change which variant gets the load.
Alex: ah good catch. Could be routing bias moving a subset to a smaller instance. Can we confirm instance sizes for canary?
Maria: canary pool currently: 2x g4dn.xlarge + 1x g4dn.12xlarge as overflow.
Sam: if small instances get unevened drift, they could hit per-instance rate limits despite global allowances. I'll validate routing tags and per-node accounting.
Alex: if anyone has time, please review my tiny PR: https://git.internal/redwood/gateway/pull/3124 — it's the metric export fix. Need 1 approver to unblock deploy.
Leah: I'll give it a pass after lunch.
Jamal: deploy bot patched staging rollout at 08:12 — DeployBot: \"staging/gateway v2.13.7 started\" :rocket:
DeployBot: \"healthcheck: gateway-staging returned 200 for 7/7 targets\"
Sam: plan for today: reproduce 429 locally with env parity, instrument per-node counters, check spillover into the routing layer.
Maria: I'll help correlate logs between auth-proxy and gateway (look for 401->429 patterns).
Alex: thanks. blockers: need a second on PR, and someone to pair on reproducer (Sam?). If we can't repro by EOD, roll back auth-proxy jitter change.
Leah: noted. schedule pairing at 11:30 if that works for you @Sam and @Alex.
Alex: 11:30 works. small ask: if you touch ratepolicy config, please bump the policy version so telemetry shows the diff.
Jamal: will do.
Alex: thanks team — short and actionable. :thumbsup:
Maria: quick FYI — I'll open an eval to track quality/regression tied to this routing change (just in case).
Sam: ack, will bring logs to pairing.
Leah: LGTM on the metric fix once CI finishes.
Alex: last note — ticket created: INF-4823 with reproduction steps + links to PR + logs. Adding folks.
